summary: The comment argues that mobile phone base station emissions can pose health risks, especially to children, and calls for stricter controls on their placement near schools. No policy claims related to the FCC E‑Rate topics are present in the provided text.

claims.requested_action: restrict placement of base station antennas near schools
claims.argument: Mobile phone base station emissions can exceed health guidance levels and may cause adverse health effects in children.
claims.evidence_quote:
Using a Powerwatch-designed Acoustimeter to measure the emissions from
base station antennas mounted on a water tower. This shows peak and
average signal levels and also holds the highest peak value

filer_raw: Kevin Mottus | Outreach Director, CA Brain Tumor Assn
